SAMPLE.subject: Payout timing
SAMPLE.snippet: Hi Jane, your payout was approved this morning...
SAMPLE.message: "Hi Jane, your payout was approved this morning and goes out through Rise today."
SAMPLE.reply_time: We usually reply within 4 hours during support hours.
SAMPLE.payout_rule: 5 winning days of $100+ for each payout
SAMPLE.decision: We reviewed the trades on FS-50K-10432 again and found they met the rules. The account is open again with the balance it had before it was closed.

confirm.w: Right after sign-up, with a 6-digit code.
confirm.p: Enter it to finish creating your account.
b: Enter this code on the sign-up screen to confirm it's really you. It works for 30 minutes.
confirm.n2: Didn't sign up? Ignore this email, or tell our support team.

welcome.w: Once, when a new trader confirms their email.
welcome.p: Three things worth doing before your first evaluation.
b: Funded Sky gives you a simulated futures account with clear rules. Pass the evaluation, trade a funded account, and keep up to 90% of the profit.
st: Pick an evaluation
Choose the plan and account size that fit how you trade.
Read the rules
Profit target, daily loss limit and drawdown, in plain words, on every plan.
Choose your platform
Tradovate, NinjaTrader, TradingView or Rithmic. Logins arrive by email.

firstbuy.w: 2 days after sign-up, if they haven't bought.
firstbuy.p: A simple way to pick the right account size.
b: Bigger accounts have bigger targets and more room on drawdown. Most traders pick the size where the daily loss limit matches what they'd risk on a bad day.
firstbuy.n2: Rule amounts are examples until the real plan rules are set.

order.p: Your receipt, and what happens next.
b: Your evaluation account is being created now. Login details arrive in a separate email, usually within a minute.

ready.w: When the trading account is created.
ready.s: Your {size} evaluation is ready to trade
b: Log in to {platform} with the details below. Your rules are on your dashboard and stay the same until you pass.
ready.n2: Never share your platform password. Funded Sky will never ask for it.

firstday.w: 1 day after the account is ready.
firstday.p: The three rules traders break most in week one.
st: The daily loss limit counts open trades
A losing open position can break the limit before you close it.
Drawdown follows your best balance
It moves up with your end-of-day high and never moves down.
News minutes are restricted
No new trades 2 minutes before or after high-impact releases.

payfail.w: When Finance marks a payout failed.
payfail.s: Your {amount} payout could not be sent
b: Your money is safe and still set aside for this payout. Check your payout details in Settings, then reply to this email or contact support. We will send it again or return it to your balance.

refund.s: Your refund of {amount} is on its way
refund.p: It usually shows up in 5 to 10 business days.
b: We sent the refund to the card you paid with. Banks usually show it within 5 to 10 business days. The evaluation account on this order is closed.

abandon1.w: 2 hours after leaving checkout, if still unpaid.
abandon1.p: Use your code for {pct} off in the next {hours} hours.
b: Use code {code} for {pct} off. It works once, for you only, for the next {hours} hours.

abandon2.p: {code} stops working in a few hours.
b: After that, {code} stops working and the price goes back to {full}. Your cart is saved exactly as you left it.

halfway.w: When profit reaches 50% of the target.
b: Halfway is where many traders size up and give it back. Your daily loss limit and drawdown haven't changed.

target.w: When the target is hit before the minimum trading days.
target.s: Target hit. {days} more trading days to go.
target.p: Trade on {days} more days to pass.
b: You need at least {min_days} trading days to pass. Place at least one trade on each remaining day, and stay inside the rules.

dailywarn.n: Close to Your Daily Loss Limit
dailywarn.w: When today's loss reaches 80% of the limit.
dailywarn.s: You're at 80% of today's loss limit
dailywarn.p: Another {left} loss pauses trading until 5:00 PM ET.
al: Today: −{lost} of the {limit} daily loss limit. Another {left} loss, open or closed, pauses trading on {account} until the day resets at 5:00 PM ET.
b: Hitting the daily limit does not close the account. It stops trading for the rest of the day.

ddwarn.w: When the balance is within 20% of the drawdown floor.
ddwarn.s: You are {left} from your drawdown floor
al: Balance {balance}. {account} closes if it falls below {floor}, including open trades.
b: The floor follows your highest end-of-day balance. It never moves down.

consistency.w: When one day is more than the consistency limit of total profit.
consistency.s: One day is carrying most of your profit
consistency.p: Spread profit over more days before you {what}.
b: To {what}, no single day can be more than {limit} of your profit. Spreading profit over more days fixes it.

inactive1.s: Your account closes after 30 days without a trade
b: Accounts close after 30 days without a trade. Place one trade in the next 9 days to keep it open.

inactive2.w: 7 days later, if still no trades.
inactive2.p: One trade before Nov 24 keeps it open.
al: No trades for 28 days. The account closes on Nov 24 unless a trade is placed.

breach.w: When an evaluation rule is broken.
b: The account broke the {rule} rule. No more trades can be placed on it. Your trade history stays on your dashboard.
breach.n2: Think it's a mistake? Reply within 7 days and we'll review the trades.

resetoffer.w: 1 day after a breach, if they haven't reset or bought.
resetoffer.p: Same account and rules, back to a fresh balance.
b: Reset {account} to its starting balance with the same rules and login. Trading days and history start over.

winback.w: 30 days after a breach, if still no purchase.
winback.p: What traders who pass on their second try do differently.
b: Traders who come back usually trade fewer contracts and stop for the day earlier. Your old dashboard shows where your last account ended.
Your account is back to its starting balance. Trading days start again from zero.

passed.w: When every evaluation rule is met.
passed.p: Three steps to your funded account.
b: Three steps to your funded account. Most traders finish them in a day.
st: Verify your identity
A passport or ID and a quick selfie. About 3 minutes.
Sign the funded agreement
Payout terms and funded rules, in plain words.
Pay the activation fee
Only if your plan has one. Then your funded account goes live.

kyc.w: When a passed trader hasn't verified yet.
kyc.s: One step left: verify your identity
kyc.p: A photo ID and a selfie. About 3 minutes.
b: We're required to check who we pay. You'll need a passport, ID card or driver's license, and a phone camera.
kyc.n2: Checks are run by our identity partner. We never see your full document number.

b: Your identity check passed. Next, sign your funded agreement.

kycmore.w: When the identity check needs more information.
kycmore.p: Your photo was hard to read.
al: The photo of your ID was blurry. Retake it in good light, with all four corners showing.

kycno.w: When the identity check is rejected.
kycno.p: What this means, and how to appeal.
b: Funded accounts can't be opened and payouts can't be sent until your identity is verified. Check your details and send them again from Settings, Identity.
If you think this is wrong, reply to this email within 14 days.

agreement.s: Your funded agreement is ready to sign
agreement.p: Payout terms and funded rules, in plain words.
b: It covers your profit split, payout schedule and the rules on the funded account. It takes about 5 minutes to read.

actfee.w: After signing, on plans with an activation fee.
b: Plans with the No Activation Fee add-on skip this step.

funded.w: When the funded account is created.
funded.p: Your login, and when your first payout can happen.
b: Your funded account is ready on {platform}. Profit you make is paid out at your split.

certificate.w: 1 day after the funded account goes live.
certificate.p: A certificate with your name on it, ready to share.
b: Your certificate shows your name, account size and the date you passed. Download it or share it straight to X or LinkedIn.

fbreach.w: When a funded account rule is broken.
fbreach.s: Your funded account has been closed
fbreach.p: What happened, and what happens to your profit.
b: The account broke the {rule} rule. Profit from before the breach that met the payout rules can still be requested for 30 days.

eligible.w: When a funded account meets the payout rules.
eligible.s: Your first payout is ready to request

payreq.p: Reviews usually take 1 to 2 business days.
b: We check the trades against the payout rules, then send it through Rise.

payok.p: It goes out through Rise today.

paysent.s: {amount} is on its way to you
b: Rise usually shows it in your account within a few hours.

paycert.w: 3 days after a payout is sent.
paycert.p: Proof of your {amount} payout, ready to share.
b: Your payout certificate shows the amount and date. Share it from Rewards, or keep it for yourself.

payhold.w: When a request needs a manual review.
payhold.s: Your payout needs a closer look
payhold.p: We'll update you within 3 business days.
al: Some trades need a manual review against the funded rules. Nothing is needed from you right now.

risesetup.w: When a funded trader has no payout method.
risesetup.s: Set up Rise to get paid
b: Payouts are sent through Rise, in USD or crypto. Create your Rise account with the same email you use here.

taxform.w: Before the first payout, when no tax form is on file.
taxform.s: One form before your first payout
taxform.p: W-9 for US traders, W-8BEN for everyone else.
b: US traders fill in a W-9. Everyone else fills in a W-8BEN. It takes about 3 minutes.

renewsoon.w: 3 days before a monthly plan renews.

al: We couldn't charge Visa ending 4242. We'll try again on Nov 27. Your account keeps running until then.

renewfail2.s: Second try failed: update your card
al: The second try failed. Your account pauses on Nov 30 if the renewal is still unpaid.

renewpause.p: Pay the renewal to pick up where you left off.
b: No trades can be placed until the renewal is paid. Your balance and progress are kept for 30 days.

subcancel.w: When a trader cancels a monthly plan.
b: You can keep trading until the end of the period you paid for, Dec 25, 2026.

cardexp.w: When the saved card expires this month.
cardexp.s: Your card on file expires this month
cardexp.p: Update it to keep renewals running.
b: Visa ending 4242 expires at the end of November. Update it before your next renewal on Dec 25.

pwreset.w: When a trader asks to reset their password.
b: Use the button below to choose a new password. The link works for 30 minutes and only once.
pwreset.n2: Didn't ask for this? Ignore this email. Your password won't change.

pwchanged.p: If this wasn't you, lock your account now.

newlogin.w: When someone signs in from a new device.
newlogin.n2: If it was you, there is nothing to do.

twofa.w: When two-step login is turned on or off.
b: From now on you will enter a code from your authenticator app when you sign in.

emailchg.w: Sent to the old address when the email changes.
emailchg.s: Your Funded Sky email was changed
emailchg.p: If this wasn't you, tell us right away.
b: Our support team changed the email on your account. If you did not ask for this, reply to this email right away.

delreq.w: When a trader asks to delete their account.
delreq.s: We got your request to delete your account
b: Open evaluations close and your personal data is deleted, except records we must keep by law, like orders and payouts. If you change your mind, reply to this email before then.

export.w: When a requested data export finishes.
export.p: The download link works for 7 days.
b: The file includes your profile, orders, accounts and trade history.

review.w: When trades are flagged for a manual review.
review.s: Some of your trades are under review
review.p: You can keep trading. We'll update you within 3 business days.
b: Our risk team is checking a few trades against the rules. You can keep trading while we look. We'll email you within 3 business days.

strategy.w: When trading matches a prohibited strategy.
strategy.s: A warning about your recent trades
strategy.p: One more time and the account closes.
al: Trades on Nov 20 match a prohibited strategy: opposite positions on two accounts at the same time. A second time closes both accounts.

suspended.w: When staff lock an account (Users, Lock Account).
suspended.p: What this means, and how to reach us.
b: Our team locked your account while we review it. Until it is unlocked you can't sign in, buy accounts, ask for payouts or redeem credits. Your trading accounts are not closed.
Reply to this email to explain or ask why. We'll tell you when the review is done.

banned.w: When staff ban a trader (Users, Ban User).
banned.s: Your Funded Sky account is closed
banned.p: What this means for your accounts.
b: We closed your Funded Sky account. You can no longer sign in, and your open trading accounts were closed.
If you think this is a mistake, reply to this email within 14 days.

reinstated.w: When risk reinstates a closed account.
reinstated.p: Back at its balance from the start of that day.
b: We reviewed the closure and reinstated the account. It is back at its balance from the start of the day it closed, with the same loss floor as before.

appeal.w: When a trader appeals a decision.
appeal.p: A different reviewer will decide within 5 business days.
b: Someone who wasn't part of the first decision will review it within 5 business days.
{decision}

news.w: The evening before a high-impact release.
news.p: No new trades 2 minutes either side.

holiday.w: A few days before a market holiday.
b: Days with no trading don't count toward minimum trading days.

platswitch.w: When a trader moves an account to another platform.

maint.p: Dashboard offline 2:00 to 3:00 AM ET. Trading is not affected.

outage.w: When a platform outage affects accounts.
outage.p: No account will be closed because of it.
al: Tradovate is having connection problems. No account will be closed for rule breaks caused by the outage.

affok.w: When an affiliate application is approved.
affok.p: Your code and link are inside.

commission.p: A trader bought through your link or code {code}.

ticket.w: When a trader opens a support ticket.
b: {reply_time} Reply to this email to add anything.

reply.w: When support replies to a ticket.
b: {message}
Your ticket is closed. Tell us if it was solved. If not, we'll reopen it right away.

brief.s: This week: CPI, Fed speakers, and holiday hours
brief.p: The 5 things that move futures this week.
st: CPI on Tuesday
The biggest release of the week. News rule applies.
Fed speakers
Three on Wednesday. Expect wider ranges.
Thanksgiving hours
Closed Thursday, early close Friday.

sale.w: When a campaign starts, like Black Friday.
b: Use code BLACKFRIDAY at checkout, through Nov 30. Works on every plan and size.

product.p: Rithmic is here, and payouts got faster.
st: Rithmic accounts
Pick Rithmic at checkout on every plan.
Faster payouts
Most payouts now go out the same day.

reviewask.p: Two minutes, and it helps other traders.
b: A short review helps other traders decide. It takes two minutes.

paydeny.w: When Risk denies a payout request.
paydeny.p: The amount is back in your account.
paydeny.a: The amount is back in your account.
b: The amount we set aside for this payout is back in your account balance. Contact support if you have questions.

payretry.w: When Finance retries a failed payout.
b: We'll email you again when it has been sent.
